header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ﵄ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ يَقْبَلُ تَوْبَةَ الْعَبْدِ مَالَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ:هذا حديث حسن غريب باب ان الله يقبل توبة العبد ...رقم:٣٥٣٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “Allah Ta'ala accepts the Tawbah of a servant as long as the moment of the soul leaving the body has not come.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.text: Explanation:- At the time of death, when the servant's soul is departing from the body, a kind of sound comes from the throat. It is called “Ghargharah”. After it there remains no sign of life at all. This is the certain, final sign of death. That is why Tawbah or accepting Iman after this sign appears is not accepted.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بن عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِﷺ: مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِعَامٍ تِيبَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّي قَالَ بِشَهْرٍ حَتَّي قَالَ بِجُمْعَةٍ حَتَّي قَالَ بِيَوْمٍ حَتَّي قَالَ بِسَاعَةٍ حَتَّي قَالَ بِفُوَاقٍ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “If a person makes Tawbah a year before his death, it will be accepted; likewise if he makes Tawbah a month, a week, a day, or an hour before; and even if he makes Tawbah before the short interval between milking a camel once and milking it again, it will be accepted.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَن أَخْطَأَ خَطِيئَةً أَوْ أَذْنَبَ ذَنْباً ثُمَّ نَدِمَ فَهُوَ كَفَّارَتُهُ.
